plan.title: ADR-002: Forge-provider Azure DevOps adoption gate (proposed)

narratives.Description: Record the Proposed ADR that #2651 and children #2715-#2733 must not be implemented until explicit maintainer buy-in; default posture defers the program past 1.0.0. Operational hold (status:blocked + Blocked-by rewrite) is applied on GitHub; this story covers the durable ADR document under docs/decisions/.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Author docs/decisions/ADR-002-forge-provider-azure-adoption.md (Status: proposed). 2) Cross-link from #2651 (issue comment + body caution). 3) Keep children held until ADR moves to accepted/deferred with a schedule. Do not promote or activate any #2715-#2733 implementation stories under this xBRIEF.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer planning 1.0, I want a citable adoption gate for the Azure forge program so AFK children cannot silently start a GitHub-extraction rewrite without buy-in.

narrative.Acceptance: ADR-002 file exists with Status proposed, open questions, and default defer-past-1.0 posture.
Issue #2651 body/comment points at ADR-002; children Blocked-by cite the ADR path.

items.title: Maintain operational hold until adoption decision

narrative.Acceptance: Children #2715-#2733 remain status:blocked until ADR status changes and hold is explicitly lifted.
